items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I don't remember, Jenny, from after World War I.

ctx.x: So the old, the old original Sam Morgan Band was back, was that before World War I? Or after World War I?

Oh, no, I would have been in the- Well, I don't remember, Jenny, from after World War I. It was- Yeah. I was much younger then, because that's happened around then. Yeah. Yeah. The World War, just about nine months. But Young Morgan, I mean Andrew, my time of seeing the bands during them, they was around 90, 90, 90, 20. Yeah, after the war. Right. That was way before the Young Morgan Band started out, do you think? Oh, yeah, Sam had this band before Young Morgan Band. Oh, yeah, yeah.
Naturally, yeah. And that, yeah. Yeah. And I think the band that recorded, what's the United 27 or something?
